data.heading: 1. Kharif Season Sowing Status:
data.text: -  Kharif  sowing  data  collection  has  started  from  05 th June,  2026  and  the  sowing  is  in  preliminary stage. As on 12 June 2026, the area sown under Kharif crops is 84.60 lakh ha (including 54.08 lakh ha in Sugarcane) as compared to 88.04 lakh ha during the corresponding period of last year.

data.heading: Week 1 (12 June  - 18 June 2026):
data.text:
-  Maximum temperatures is likely to be above normal over Rajasthan, East India, NE India, & West Coast.
-  Low probability of Heatwave conditions very likely in isolated pockets over Coastal Andhra Pradesh & Yanam during 11th-12th June; Telangana during 11th-13th June; Vidarbha during 11th-12th June.

data.heading: Details of each Segment
data.text: -  Hot  and  humid  weather  conditions  likely  to  prevail  over  Konkan  &  Goa  during  11th-13th  June; Madhya Maharashtra during 11th-12th June.

data.heading: Week 2 (19 June - 25 June 2026):
data.text:
-  Maximum temperatures is likely to be above normal NW India, East India, NE India, and Central & West India.
-  Low  probability  of  Heatwave  conditions  likely  over  parts  of  northwest  India  (Rajasthan,  Punjab, Haryana & Uttar Pradesh) on some days of the week.
-  No Warm Night conditions likely during the Week.

data.heading: 6.      PEST & DISEASE
data.text: -  The overall intensity of pests and diseases remained below the Economic Threshold Level.
